plain_english.headline: A narrow market, with volatility around normal.
because: A handful of big names are carrying the index — the average stock is falling behind. This has been going on long enough to look tired. Breadth is near the bottom of its 12-month range, which is usually where it turns.
Single stocks are moving about as much as the index. The index itself is quiet, with VIX at 15.5, lower than 79% of the past two years.
Option dealers are positioned in a way that damps moves — rallies get sold into and dips get bought.
Trend-following funds are mixed across the 18 markets we track, and 4 of those positions are stretched. Crowded trades unwind quickly, so the size guidance is cut.

Together, that is a fragile setup, not a confident one: a lot of money is already leaning the same way, so a break past the levels below would force that SAME money to reverse fast, accelerating whatever move already started rather than fading it.

4 warning signs lit: other markets are not confirming the move, the average stock is not following the index, breadth is rolling over toward its own average and single-stock volatility is pulling away from the index. A further 5 showed up on individual markets. No single one of these is a reason to sell. They matter when several point the same way as the breadth reading.
plain_english.so_what: Pair it up: short the stretched leader against the average stock. That is the closest fit rather than a clean one — 1 of its conditions are not met. Size at 0.65x your normal risk (cut because the trend is crowded).
watch_for: If the 2-year trades above 103.44 (1.6% away), trend funds start buying.
If small caps trades below 2,793.10 (1.8% away), trend funds start selling.
Watch for single stocks becoming more volatile while the index stays calm. That gap is the earliest warning we get.
Watch for the average stock keeping pace with the index again. That ends the leadership trade and starts the breadth trade.
plain_english.note: Written from the numbers on this page every time it runs. When the data changes, this changes with it.
